chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Three are the closest of creation to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, on the Day of Resurrection until He completes the Reckoning: a man whose power in the state of his anger does not lead him to oppress those under his authority; a man who walks between two and does not lean toward one of them over the other by even a barleycorn; and a man who speaks the truth whether it is against him or in his favor.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people closest to Allah on the Day of Judgment according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identified three types of people who will be closest to Allah on the Day of Judgment. This hadith, transmitted through a strong chain including Muhammad ibn Muslim (a prominent companion), emphasizes three fundamental virtues in Islamic ethics: self-restraint during anger, impartiality in mediation, and truthfulness regardless of personal interest. The 'barleycorn' metaphor illustrates the extreme precision of fairness expected.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
